rca of the issue: Team Calls 'Connected' count always shows 0 because backend calls.py get_team_call_logs queries {'call_outcome': {'$in': ['connected','answered']}} but call log documents are inserted with field name 'outcome' (see routes/calls.py create_call_log and end_call_session). Fix: change query field to 'outcome'.
